title: Fragile Freight Transfer
brief: A container of sensitive equipment must be moved from the ship to the landside transfer bay. Excessive acceleration can cause unsecured cargo inside the container to shift. Deliver the container as quickly as possible without exceeding the cargo limit, striking an obstacle, or arriving with residual motion.

scoring.description: Container center must be within target tolerance of the target bay.
Trolley must be within final-speed tolerance of rest.
Trolley speed must not exceed the configured maximum.
Trolley acceleration must not exceed the configured maximum (cargo-shift proxy for the first release).
Transfer should complete within the cycle-time goal.
